Polling Place Lookup
The precincts below are new precincts established effective January 15, 2022, and will be in place through the 2031 city and school election. The county has added seven precincts this decade for a total of 64.

Polling place hours are from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. for all elections.
Satellite polling locations for future elections must be petitioned by eligible electors. Please use this form and contact the Johnson County Auditor's Office with any questions.
